# `item.place`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/item.place.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`item.place` (`PlaceItem`, WP-S2.04 §5.1; FR-SYM-023, FR-SYM-024, FR-SYM-025): creates a page item on a page, a
graphic (`{"graphic": {shape, stroke?, dash?, fill?}}`), a free text (`{"free_text": {text, bind?, at, angle?,
style?, align?}}`) or an image (`{"image": {asset | data, rect}}`, part 5: an asset of the project's store, or the
image file as base64 `data`, which the command validates and stores as the company logo is stored, in the
rectangle of two opposite corners, stored with the smaller coordinates first), absolute in page nm; a rectangle is
stored with `min` the smaller coordinates. Rejected: a missing page (not found); a degenerate shape (a zero-length
line, a polyline or polygon with fewer than two or three distinct points, a rectangle without area, a radius of 0,
an arc without sweep) or a stroke width of 0 or less, at
`/kind/graphic`; a `bind` that is not one of the six bindable names, an empty `text` without `bind`, or an angle
other than 0, 90000, 180000 or 270000, at `/kind/free_text`; an image with both or neither of `asset` and `data`, or
whose rectangle has no area, at `/kind/image`; one whose asset the project does not hold, at `/kind/image/asset`;
one whose `data` is no accepted image file (the logo's checks and texts), at `/kind/image/data`. Interactive.
Outcome: the item.

## Types

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

### ItemKindParam

What `item.place` places: `{"graphic": {…}}`, `{"free_text": {…}}` or `{"image": {…}}`.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: A graphic (FR-SYM-023).

   Shape: object { `graphic`: [`GraphicParam`](#graphicparam) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `graphic` | [`GraphicParam`](#graphicparam) | yes |  | A graphic of `item.place`. |

2. **Form 2**: A free text (FR-SYM-024).

   Shape: object { `free_text`: [`FreeTextParam`](#freetextparam) }

   | Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `free_text` | [`FreeTextParam`](#freetextparam) | yes |  | A free text of `item.place`. |

3. **Form 3**: An image asset in a rectangle (FR-SYM-025, part 5).

   Shape: object { `image`: [`ImageParam`](#imageparam) }

   |---|---|---|---|---|
   | `image` | [`ImageParam`](#imageparam) | yes |  | An image of `item.place` (WP-S2.04 part 5, FR-SYM-025). |

| `align` | [`AlignParam`](#alignparam) or `null` | no |  | The horizontal alignment at `at`; default left. |

### AlignParam

The horizontal alignment of a free text at its point.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"left"` | The text starts at the point. |
| `"centre"` | The text is centred on the point. |
| `"right"` | The text ends at the point. |

### CmdAngle2

An angle in 10^-3 degree, counter-clockwise on the sheet (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: integer (min -2147483648, max 2147483647)

### CmdIdent

An identifier: non-empty, one line, NFC, without leading or trailing white space (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### CmdMlText

Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags in ascending order with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2).

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**

   Shape: string

2. **Form 2**

   Shape: map of string (at least 1 character(s)) (at least 1 propert(ies))

### CmdPt2

A point or a displacement [x, y] in nanometres, y downwards (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: array of (integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)) (at least 2 item(s), at most 2 item(s))

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
